primary_outcome: the audit report the fixed driver prints for one driver log follows FM-4: per-day driving and on-duty minutes, per-day violation minutes under rules 3.1-3.4, and time left at the end of the log

obligations.contribution: driving time is the driving status plus yard moves (on-duty time in a stretch covering one mile or more); rest stays rest whatever the truck's miles

authority.anchor: A yard move is on-duty time in a stretch in which the truck covers one

separability.rationale: the classification or limit feeds the violation minutes and time left of the same audit report

obligations.discriminating_instance: on stretches at 0.9 and 1.0 miles; a sleeper stretch of a team truck covering 480 miles that makes a reset; an off-duty personal-conveyance stretch that makes a break
obligations.wrong_but_plausible: count every stretch in which the truck covers a mile or more as driving time, sleeper and off-duty included

obligations.contribution: a shift opens at the first on-duty minute after a reset, not the first driving minute

authority.anchor: A shift begins at the first minute of on-duty time after a reset

separability.rationale: the classification or limit feeds the violation minutes and time left of the same audit report

obligations.discriminating_instance: a shift that opens with 90 minutes of pre-trip on-duty time before driving, run close to its window; rest periods of 599 and 600 minutes
obligations.wrong_but_plausible: keep opening the shift at the first driving minute

obligations.contribution: the 14-hour window runs on the clock from the shift start, rest included, both for violations and for time left

authority.anchor: The window runs on the clock

separability.rationale: the classification or limit feeds the violation minutes and time left of the same audit report

obligations.discriminating_instance: a shift with a 3-hour rest in the middle that drives into its 14th clock hour; a log ending 13h59 into a shift
obligations.wrong_but_plausible: count only on-duty minutes toward the window, or fix the walk but not the time-left figure

obligations.contribution: only a rest period of 30 minutes or more is a break; on-duty-not-driving time is not

authority.anchor: A break is a rest period of 30 minutes or more

separability.rationale: the classification or limit feeds the violation minutes and time left of the same audit report

obligations.discriminating_instance: 45 minutes of on-duty fuelling between two driving stretches; a 29-minute and a 30-minute rest mixing off and sleeper time
obligations.wrong_but_plausible: keep accepting any 30 non-driving minutes, or require the break to be a single status

obligations.contribution: 10 hours of driving time per shift

authority.anchor: A driver may drive 10 hours in a shift

separability.rationale: the classification or limit feeds the violation minutes and time left of the same audit report

obligations.contribution: the cycle total is this day's earlier on-duty time plus the six days before, against 60 hours, with recap days

authority.anchor: The cycle total at a minute is the driver's on-duty time earlier on that

separability.rationale: the classification or limit feeds the violation minutes and time left of the same audit report

obligations.discriminating_instance: a recap whose oldest day is heavy, and a day on which the cycle total reaches exactly 3600 minutes mid-stretch
obligations.wrong_but_plausible: keep 70 hours over eight days, or count only whole earlier days

obligations.contribution: a violation minute counts on the calendar day it falls in

authority.anchor: counts on the day it falls in

separability.rationale: the classification or limit feeds the violation minutes and time left of the same audit report

obligations.discriminating_instance: a shift that starts at 20:00 and runs past the driving limit after midnight
obligations.wrong_but_plausible: attribute a shift's violation minutes to the day the shift began

obligations.contribution: time left from nought up is reported rounded down to a tenth of an hour; for time left the manual does not provide for, the minutes follow the manual and the shipped conversion to hours stands

authority.anchor: rounded down to a tenth of an hour

separability.rationale: the classification or limit feeds the violation minutes and time left of the same audit report

obligations.discriminating_instance: time left of 3, 5, 6 and 59 minutes; time left of -7, -35 and -660 minutes under each limit (never -1 or -2, where the shipped conversion prints -0.0)
obligations.wrong_but_plausible: round every time-left figure down, or clamp it at nought

universal_rule.anchor: Every rule in the manual holds for every log within the limits of its section 1

silence.anchor: Where the manual gives no rule for a value the package reports

coverage_envelope.anchor: Logs of one to fourteen days will be audited

seeds: solution/seal.py SEED constant (authoring only; graded logs are sealed files)

unclaimed_units_rationale.test_outputs.py::test_generated_logs: seeded trap-free logs across section 1; exercises all obligations together

exact_output_requirements.rationale: the safety team's findings tool reads this JSON; keys and day order are fixed by FM-4 section 6

authority_anchor.anchor: The audit prints one JSON object with the keys

exact_output_requirements.rationale: violation minutes are keyed by the manual's rule numbers
dispatch quotes time left conservatively, to the tenth of an hour below

authority_anchor.anchor: rounded down to a tenth of an hour
time left is compared as a number to within 0.001
